notes: Three distinct localized open-close episodes are visible: two separate cycles involving the dark green chair, followed by one cycle involving the blue chair. Transition frames are estimated at the midpoint of the visible manipulation intervals.
scene_description: Bright bedroom with a bed, standing desk, large window, and folding camp chairs manipulated in two different wall corners.
